title: Population-polynomial all-anchor actual first-abnormal occupation and output contract
statement: For the unchanged exact six-species process,all positive raw rates and every actual physical input x,the first abnormal stop sigma under the existing global normal policy satisfies E integral_0^sigma(1+M_t)^r dt<=C_r(1+M_in)^(r+2) and E(1+M_out)^p<=D_p(1+M_in)^p for every integer r,p>=0,with acquired raw scalar constants. In particular E sigma<=C_0(1+M_in)^2 and E J_full(sigma)<=C(1+M_in)^9.

requires: Exact original two C3 ports/reversible pair,positive raw alpha0..3,beta0..3,kf,kb,falling-factorial physical propensities and actual nonnegative integer input x. M is total physical population.
Retain the all-anchor normal policy and exact signed-class reference mu from v1. No stationary actual input,normal reset,uniform mixing gap or changed physical clock is assumed.
Use the REAL mu-adjoint generator and unchanged killing h. Reverse packet activation is a mathematical adjoint operation,not a new physical reaction/intervention.
Acquire one raw N satisfying the explicit uniform threshold for the requested moment;head exits count as absorption and continuation uses each actual received physical state.
provides: For the unchanged exact six-species process,all positive raw rates and every actual physical input x,the first abnormal stop sigma under the existing global normal policy satisfies E integral_0^sigma(1+M_t)^r dt<=C_r(1+M_in)^(r+2) and E(1+M_out)^p<=D_p(1+M_in)^p for every integer r,p>=0,with acquired raw scalar constants. In particular E sigma<=C_0(1+M_in)^2 and E J_full(sigma)<=C(1+M_in)^9.

For h(m)=log(|m|!),Phi(z)=min_l sum_i[h(z_i+l*w_i)-(z_i+l*w_i)log(theta_i)+theta_i+theta_i^-1],the signed rank-one convex integer minimum is acquired by doubling/binary search. E=1+Phi+log(A!)-Alog(theta_A)+theta_A+log(D!)-Dlog(theta_D)+theta_D is nonnegative,proper and core invariant. Fixed residual shifts cost O_raw(log(2+M));all terminals preserve hidden Phi,not the full anchor energy.

On the entire unbounded normal class,mu=R^l*(alpha0/alpha3)^floor(A/3)*(beta0/beta3)^floor(D/3)/[alpha_(Amod3)*beta_(Dmod3)*A!B!C!D!E!F!],R=kf/kb,has exact normal adjoint defect zero,including cold zeros. mu is a summable invariant finite measure for Q;normal nonexplosion and closed positive recurrent normal components (absorbing normal states allowed) are source-claimed for Q only.

The exact normal adjoint reverses growth0 at residue1 with source1 hazard;growth1 at residue2 with source2 hazard;growth2 at residue0 with terminal hazard;reverse terminal creates (+3A,+2B,+2C) at constant source0 rate,portwise. Both core directions are unchanged;the killing h is the same.

For D_L={M<=L},kill at h OR actual normal head exit. With b=min(alpha0,beta0),B=alpha0+beta0,c1=max(alpha1,beta1),c2=max(alpha2,beta2),t0=24min(alpha3,beta3),forward mean<=C_F L^2 and reverse mean<=C_R L^4,where C_F=1/b+(1/B+1/b)(1+c1/b),C_R=1/b+(1/B+1/t0+1/b)(1+c2/b). Reverse head exits,including constant packet jumps,are paid.

For R=kf/kb,Kc=max(1,R,R^-1),Kp=max(1,alpha0/alpha3,beta0/beta3),t=6KcKp,rmin=min(1,alpha0/alpha3,beta0/beta3),Cx=Kc/rmin,G0=alpha0+alpha1+alpha2+beta0+beta1+beta2,D0=32 C_R G0 Kc^2 alpha_max beta_max/(alpha_min beta_min),choose N>=3,N>=t+2,N+1>=2Cx t^2,N+1>=2^9 t^2 and D0*2^17*8!*N^8*t^(2N)/N!<=delta. Logarithmic scalar testing/doubling acquires a uniform N for ALL input masses n,not an unevaluated head-by-head oracle.

At L=2(n+N),every actual normal head-exit probability is<=delta. Continue from its true mass<=L+3. Z=M+2N+3 obeys Z_next<=2Z on each genuine failed head. With delta=2^(-r-3),E integral_0^sigma(1+M_t)^r dt<=8 C_F 2^r(M_in+2N+3)^(r+2). With delta<=2^(-p-1),E(1+M_out)^p<=2^(p+1)(M_in+2N+3)^p. These cutoffs do not change sigma or restart the physical state.

The actual full-rate compensator gives population-degree9 expected genuine stopped jump count. All normal histories,peer/core paths and every abnormal/terminal output are retained. Polynomial receiver bounds can receive these moments;their inward signed decrement remains a separate obligation.
assumptions: The earlier exact unbounded normal reference,normal nonexplosion and signed phase chart remain at their valid source scope. Normal Q invariance is not full-chain stationarity.

Finite adjoint Green comparison,channel compensators and strong-Markov renewal sum over all actual failed heads. No favorable head-boundary receiving law or conditional rare-success duration is imposed.
N can be chosen separately for each moment;the physical first-abnormal stop is common and cutoff independent. Program/result cases are finite support,not the all-state theorem.
costs: Acquire forward/reverse clock constants and one uniform raw head offset N from explicit scalar inequalities/logarithmic doubling. Occupation uses delta=2^(-r-3),output moments delta<=2^(-p-1);N may differ by moment. Constants are deliberately loose and rate dependent. This is population-polynomial,not polynomial bit-length complexity or practical advantage.

Earlier reciprocal-input-weight constants remain a valid weaker bound in immutable v1. The stronger population-polynomial bound does not provide polynomial runtime in binary input length or practical numerical performance. Supplied finite constants are deliberately enormous;the scalar-acquisition program is preserved without execution.
contract.units: Actual physical time,polynomial spatial occupation,full stopped jump count and every polynomial terminal mass/reward moment.
contract.obstruction: Output integrability and physical clock do not supply inward receiver decrement,full-chain invariant law or full recurrence. No general weak-reversibility theorem or signed-energy repayment follows from polynomial exit mass moments. Earlier reciprocal-input-weight reference/contract remains valid but weaker;immutable unit v1 and its sources are retained. Earlier signed trace failure,scoped source-current/returns and the P1 return retain their scopes.

This version strengthens the actual clock/occupation/output contract through finite protected heads,the true normal adjoint and renewal over every actual head output. It does not establish an inward common receiver. Original programs/results are data,not executed.
